newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasuries little changed in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasuries little changed in dull trade.

text.p: *US Treasuries flat to slightly lower in dull summer session.
*Jun US retail sales failed to provide real trading incentive.
*T-bond seen holding above 6.50-pct yield ahead of new supply.
*Some concern dollar, US assets may be topping out this summer
*US June CPI due out Wed, seen up 0.2 pct vs May's up 0.1 pct.
